name: gateway_run_wrap_current_message_with_observed_context
notes: Wraps the current user turn with observed Telegram group context. Input encoding '<observed_context>\t<message>' over argv. Harness is a faithful traced copy of src/gateway/run_pure2.c::gw_wrap_current_message_with_observed_context (run_pure2.c itself drags config/hash/logger deps, so it is not linked; header strings copied byte-for-byte from the port). Value event hashes the LIVE-returned wrapped string. SCOPE: only the str-message path — the C port implements no list-of-parts / non-str branches (LIVE wraps the first {'type':'text'} part or prepends a synthetic one); that gap is a real port limitation noted for follow-up, not exercised here.
